  • Constructor Details

    • Novel

      public Novel(int release, String title, String synopsis, ArrayList<Genre> genres, String publisher, String author, Status status, int chapters)
      Constructs a new Novel media entry with its specific attributes.

      Precondition: genres list must not be null. chapters must be a non-negative integer.
      Postcondition: A Novel instance is initialized, storing publishing details and its layout structure.

      Parameters:
      release - The publication year of the novel.
      title - The main title of the novel.
      synopsis - A short summary or plot description of the novel.
      genres - A list of genres associated with this novel.
      publisher - The company responsible for publishing the book.
      author - The author who wrote the novel.
      status - The current tracking status.
      chapters - The total number of chapters contained in the novel.
